fields.description: Issue features extensive coverage of allegations of abuse and fraud connected to the Miami Retreat and psychiatrist Dr. T. Earl Moore (the "Torture Doctor"), urging grand jury and state medical board action and describing a "mystery woman" case and other reported mistreatment. Additional articles address Florida Power & Light and municipal ownership/public power politics, critiques of anti-gambling campaigns amid legalized pari-mutuel racing, Miami municipal court activity, proposed state utilities regulation, a DDT spraying health warning by Dr. Carlton Deederer, a Coral Way zoning dispute, and community events and letters to the editor.
